blocks.text: Joron ko kai qism ki chotein lag sakti hain jin se dard, soojan aur harkat mein kami hoti hai. Kuch aam chotein yeh hain:

Dislocation mein jor ki haddiyan zor se apni normal jagah se nikal jati hain. Yeh achanak jhatke ya chot se ho sakta hai. Shadeed dislocation mein muscles, ligaments aur tendons phat sakte hain. Alamaat: soojan, bohat tez dard aur jor ka na hil sakna. Rheumatoid arthritis bhi jor utarne ki wajah ban sakta hai. Utra hua jor doctor wapas apni jagah par bithata hai; khinche hue ligaments ki marammat ya unhen kasne ke liye operation (surgery) ki zaroorat bhi par sakti hai.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Normal elbow joint: daire mein humerus ka sira ulna ke khanche mein fit hai aur saath radius hai, paas mura hua bazu. Dislocated elbow joint: ulna aur radius humerus ke sire se peechhe dhakel diye gaye hain, aur saath ke bazu mein kohni ke peechhe ubhar hai. Labels: Humerus, Radius, Ulna.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.16: Kohni ke jor ka dislocation (kitab ki Figure 12.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke utra hua jor sirf physiotherapist hi theek kar sakta hai. Yeh sahi nahin. Utra hua jor doctor (aam taur par X-ray ke baad aur dard ki dawa ya behoshi de kar) wapas bithata hai. Physiotherapist baad mein jor ko dobara mazboot aur theek harkat ke qabil banane mein madad karta hai. Khud ya kisi ghair-tarbiyat yafta shakhs se jor bithwane ki koshish na karein.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Normal jor mein humerus ka gol sira ulna ke khanche mein beth kar hinge banata hai. Dislocation mein yeh haddiyan apni jagah se nikal jati hain, is liye kohni ki shakal bigar jati hai aur bazu hil nahin pata.

Sprain (moch) jor mein haddiyon ko jorne wale ligaments ki chot hai. Zyada tar takhne, ghutne aur kalai ke ligaments zakhmi hote hain. Yeh tab hota hai jab jor ko us ki normal had se zyada mor diya jaye aur ligaments khinch jayen ya phat jayen. Moch ka ilaj aam taur par physical therapy se hota hai. Patti (dressing) bandh kar moch wali jagah ko hilne se roka jata hai aur sahara diya jata hai.

blocks.alt: Do qataarein. Foot turned inward: nichli taang jis ka paon andar ki taraf mura (teer), aur saath bahar ki taraf se takhne ki haddiyan jahan outer ligament toota hai. Foot turned outward: paon bahar ki taraf mura, aur andar ki taraf se takhne ki haddiyan jahan inner ligament toota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.17: Takhne ki moch (ankle sprain) (kitab ki Figure 12.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Paon jis taraf murta hai, us ki ulti taraf ka ligament khinch kar toot jata hai: andar murne par bahar wala, bahar murne par andar wala. Zyada tar moch paon ke andar murne se hoti hai.
